Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Software Engineer
   

  

 Join us in unlocking infinite opportunity in Mastercard’s Commercial Solutions organization.
   

  

 In Commercial Solutions, we empower businesses with innovative, trusted payment solutions that deliver seamless, digital\-first experiences globally. We are transforming the industry by building world\-class travel and B2B platforms for corporate clients.
   

  

 As a key leader in our digital transformation journey, you will shape next\-generation financial platforms—driving architecture, scalability, and engineering excellence to deliver secure, cloud, enterprise\-scale solutions.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard is seeking a Lead Software Engineer with strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and platform architecture. You will lead the design and delivery of scalable, resilient applications powering transaction processing, analytics, APIs, and modern user experiences.
   

  

 This role combines technical, architecture ownership, and hands\-on execution, with a focus on mentoring teams and driving engineering standards across the stack.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

 Role \& Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture \& Platform Engineering
   

  

* Lead architecture and system design for large\-scale distributed cloud platforms with focus on scalability, resiliency, and security
* Design and evolve microservices, APIs, and event\-driven architectures
* Translate business requirements into robust platform solutions and technical strategy
* Own non\-functional requirements including performance, reliability, fault tolerance, and observability
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native patterns, 12\-factor principles, and domain\-driven design


 Full\-Stack \& Engineering Excellence
   

  

* Build and evolve high\-performance full\-stack applications using Java, Angular, and cloud platforms (PCF/Kubernetes)
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for code quality, security, and performance
* Lead design reviews, code reviews, and architecture governance
* Drive CI/CD, DevSecOps, and automation practices


 UI / Front\-End Leadership
   

  

* Lead development of modern Angular\-based architectures using component\-driven and micro\-frontend patterns
* Define and Build reusable UI components and scalable design systems
* Optimize applications for performance, latency, and cross\-platform compatibility


 AI \& Intelligent Systems
   

  

* Architect and integrate AI\-powered capabilities (e.g., recommendations, anomaly detection, predictive insights)
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted development tools to enhance productivity
* Ensure responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and compliance


 Collaboration
   

  

* Provide technical mentorship, elevating engineering capabilities across teams
* Influence technology strategy, frameworks, and platform evolution
* Collaborate with product, architecture, and BizOps teams to align on roadmap and delivery
* Ensure compliance with Mastercard engineering, security, and enterprise standards


 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**All About You**
 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, algorithms, and system design
* Proven experience building large\-scale distributed systems and microservices architectures
* Deep expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and backend engineering
* Strong understanding of API design, event\-driven systems, and messaging frameworks
* Experience with cloud platforms (PCF, Kubernetes)
* Solid knowledge of relational databases (Oracle) and data modeling at scale
* Expertise in performance engineering, resiliency, and scalability patterns
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Git, automated testing, and release pipelines
* Experience with observability, monitoring, and production support


 UI / Angular Expertise
   

  

* Deep expertise in Angular, TypeScript, and state management (NgRx)
* Experience with micro\-frontends and component\-driven architectures
* Strong understanding of performance optimization, lazy loading, and rendering strategies
* Familiarity with UI testing frameworks (Cypress)
* Strong focus on usability, accessibility, and intuitive design


 AI \& Modern Engineering
   

  

* Experience integrating AI/ML models via APIs or enterprise workflows
* Familiarity with GenAI/LLMs and AI\-driven product capabilities
* Understanding of data pipelines and model deployment patterns
* Ability to apply AI to enhance user experience and operational efficiency


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

DEVELOPER L4
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




 The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
 


* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities


 ͏
 
 2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
 


* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders


 ͏
 
 3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
 


* Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
* Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
* Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
* Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
* Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
* Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally


 ͏
 
**Deliver** 



**No.** 
**Performance Parameter** 
**Measure** 
 1\.Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan2\.Quality \& CSATOn\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation3\.MIS \& Reporting100% on time MIS \& report generation
 
  
 



  
 



 Mandatory Skills: Fullstack MERN
   

 .
 



  
 



 Experience: 5\-8 Years
   

 .
 



  
 



 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.
